title: Decadal circulation transition
reference_mode: Original paper period and experiment required; exact data identity not yet verified.

paper.title: Decadal climate control of circulation regime transitions in a large marginal sea

reference_text: Paper result context: upper-layer strengthening then weakening; middle-layer weakening then strengthening; deep-layer strengthening becomes prominent after 2009. The text reports approximately +6%/-2% per decade for upper circulation, middle weakening ~3% then strengthening ~13%, and deep strengthening ~15% after 2009. Match normalization and sampling before using magnitudes as numerical checks; a discrepancy requires investigation, not unsupported agreement.

criteria.description: Use 1993-2022 daily data and the paper's 750/1500 m layer boundaries. Implement its layer-integrated circulation diagnostic on the native grid or a verified equivalent, excluding invalid coastal derivative cells. Document any area normalization; do not mistake Fig. 2's normalized layer-integrated index for a simple mean of local vorticity.
criteria.evidence_requirements: Diagnostic formula, units, masks and three layer time series.
criteria.source_basis: Sections 2.1–2.2 and Eq. 1: daily1993–2022, native layer-integrated circulation.

criteria.description: Retain original and seven-year-smoothed circulation series and fit the specified 1993-2008 and 2009-2018 windows. Show temporal alignment, smoothing edge handling and trend estimates in unambiguous absolute units; document the denominator if also reporting percentage per decade.
criteria.evidence_requirements: Three-panel time series, fit windows and slope table.
criteria.source_basis: Section 3.1 and Fig. 2: seven-year smoothing and the two trend windows; endpoint handling must be frozen.

criteria.description: Quantify trend uncertainty with temporal dependence accounted for, and assess sensitivity to smoothing or fitting choices without replacing the primary windows after inspecting results. Distinguish basin-integrated changes from local surface circulation; do not claim PDO, wind or pressure causality without those inputs.
criteria.evidence_requirements: Intervals/dependence treatment, a robustness check and limitations.
criteria.source_basis: Paper discusses limits; dependence-aware uncertainty and sensitivity are added benchmark quality checks.

release_requirements: Obtain authorized, experiment-matched inputs and freeze their SHA-256 manifest.
Freeze geometry, masks, averaging conventions and all unresolved source definitions.
Compute independent numerical references and reviewed tolerances; never use an evaluated agent's output as its own reference.
Review weights, source-image rights and independent notebook execution before validated release.

scoring.weight_origin: Benchmark design choices, not paper-authored marks.

visual_scoring_policy.comparison_target: Scientific information and quantitative support, not pixel similarity.
required_invariants: Declared domain, period, baseline and valid support
Quantitative magnitudes, signs, phase, spatial or vertical structure supported by calculations
visual_scoring_policy.evidence_mapping: Match the required information collectively. One submitted figure may cover several reference panels, and several submitted figures may cover one check. A complete scientific comparison does not require one output image per reference image.
visual_scoring_policy.scoring_unit: Retain the five criterion weights and the 100-point total. Visual checks are evidence requirements within those criteria, not extra per-panel scores. Count each scientific finding once; distinct methodological and interpretive aspects may refer to the same plot.
visual_scoring_policy.full_credit: Award full credit for a criterion only when its required scientific information and nonvisual evidence are correctly demonstrated. Equivalent plots can earn full credit; matching prose or a visually similar shape without computed support cannot.
visual_scoring_policy.partial_credit: Use the existing 0-4 scale based on completeness and correctness, not the fraction of reference panels imitated. Minor readable-label omissions differ from wrong units, masks, signs or periods.
visual_scoring_policy.comparison_scope: Follow reference_mode. Q09-Q11 use approved 2018-2022 method transfers; scientifically justified disagreement with the climatological paper can earn full credit. For matched-period tasks, establish product/sample/run equivalence before imposing published numbers.
visual_scoring_policy.tolerance_policy: Do not infer exact values or invent tolerances by eye. Numerical targets require frozen inputs and independently validated diagnostics.
visual_scoring_policy.uninspected_images: If images were not supplied to a vision-capable reviewer, mark visual claims unassessed. Text, captions or filenames do not prove that unseen images are correct.
visual_scoring_policy.context_only: Do not require source-only variables, algorithms, validation datasets or panels identified as contextual. Alternative reference examples are not cumulative deliverables.
